scenario: LEXP.7.20: a schema-typed slot read is a fact reference, equal to a pattern binding exactly when the slot names that fact. `make` emits one Child per Parent, Child 1n for Parent n, its `parent` slot set to that Parent ([LGRA.5.7a.2]); Parent 1 then Parent 2, one pump. `eq` (`Child c, Parent p where c.parent == p`) fires once per child, with its own parent only; `ne` (the same with `!=`) fires once per child, with the other parent. Exactly ["eq 11/1", "eq 12/2", "ne 11/2", "ne 12/1"]: `make`'s terminal is first, so both children enter before either comparison fires; then LDET.5.4 orders `eq` before `ne`, and LDET.5.5 orders each rule's two matches by their latest fact, Child 11 before Child 12. A runtime that refused the slot read as an operand of `==`, or faulted on it, logs nothing; LEXP.7.20_slot_target_retracted separates naming a fact from naming its key. PATH PINNED: the join test over a slot read and a whole-fact read, both fact references, scanned; libds `rete/eval.c` `val_eq_unordered`'s FACT_REF arm (the slot holds the target's rete id), Mercury `ds.eval` `compare_outcome` (`fact_ref` by fact id).
rules_ds:
schema Parent scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema Child scope logical:
    id: Int key
    parent: Parent mutable

rule make:
    Parent p
->
    emit Child logical id: (p.id + 10) parent: p

rule eq:
    Child c
    Parent p where c.parent == p
->
    log info "eq {c.id}/{p.id}"

rule ne:
    Child c
    Parent p where c.parent != p
->
    log info "ne {c.id}/{p.id}"
